widgets_values:
2c - SPHERESfM FROM PANORAMAS (any pano folder -> COLMAP; dual-res OPTIONAL)

The general entry point: point it at a folder of equirect panoramas that has NO COLMAP
data yet and it builds the pinhole cube-face dataset (images/ + sparse/0/). Same node as
2b2, just used single-res -- so you can also feed it 8K panoramas_upscaled + a low-res
proxy folder and get the dual-res behaviour back.

WIRING
1. Loader 'directory' = the panorama folder to pose (e.g. <dataset>/panoramas).
   LEAVE select_every_nth = 1. Thin with the NODE's frame_stride instead -- that strides
   the hi-res files along with the frames, so dual-res stays aligned 1:1.
2. output_name = the dataset folder under ComfyUI/output.

SINGLE-RES (default here): hires_dir EMPTY -> the cube faces are reprojected from the very
frames that were posed. This is the plain SphereSfM run for non-upscaled panoramas.

DUAL-RES: put the 8K folder (e.g. <dataset>/panoramas_upscaled) in hires_dir and keep the
loader on the matching LOW-RES folder. SfM then runs cheap on the small equirects while the
faces are sampled from the 8K source. Both folders must hold the SAME frames in the SAME
sorted order and the SAME COUNT (stride in the node, not the loader).

MATCHER = exhaustive -> matches ALL frame pairs so separate trajectories can fuse into ONE
model. ON_SPLIT = stop -> if >1 model still forms, the node raises with the per-model frame
breakdown and reprojects nothing; set 'largest' to train on the biggest one anyway.

After it succeeds, train in LichtFeld (pinhole, NO --gut):
  LichtFeld-Studio.exe -d <dataset> -o <out> --headless --train --strategy mcmc --max-cap 2000000 --sh-degree 2
